questions.question: Which property sets the text color of an element?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground (text) color.

questions.question: Which selector targets elements with class="card"?
questions.explanation: A period prefix selects by class.

questions.question: In the box model, which area lies outside the border?
questions.explanation: Margin is the space outside the border; padding is inside.

questions.question: Which symbol prefixes an ID selector?
questions.explanation: #id selects the element with that id.

questions.question: Which declaration makes text bold?
questions.explanation: font-weight controls boldness.

questions.question: Which is a valid CSS comment?
questions.explanation: CSS supports only /* ... */ comments.

questions.question: What is the default value of the position property?
questions.explanation: Elements are position: static by default.

questions.question: Which declaration hides an element and removes it from layout?
questions.explanation: display: none removes the box; visibility: hidden keeps its space.

questions.question: Which selector has the highest specificity?
questions.explanation: An ID selector (1,0,0) outranks any number of class and type selectors.

questions.question: With box-sizing: content-box, width: 200px, padding: 10px and border: 2px, what is the rendered border-box width?
questions.explanation: 200 + 2x10 padding + 2x2 border = 224px.

questions.question: In a flex container, justify-content aligns items along which axis?
questions.explanation: justify-content works on the main axis set by flex-direction; align-items works on the cross axis.

questions.question: An element with position: absolute is positioned relative to:
options: Its nearest positioned ancestor (or the initial containing block if none)
questions.explanation: Absolute positioning uses the nearest ancestor whose position is not static.

questions.question: The rem unit is relative to the font size of:
questions.explanation: 1rem equals the root element's font-size; em is relative to the element's font-size.

questions.question: What does grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); create?
questions.explanation: 1fr takes one share of the free space, so three columns share it equally.

questions.question: When does @media (min-width: 768px) { ... } apply?
options: Only when the viewport is narrower than 768px
When the viewport is 768px wide or wider
questions.explanation: min-width matches widths greater than or equal to the value.

questions.question: Which of these is a pseudo-element?
questions.explanation: Pseudo-elements use :: and target part of an element; the others are pseudo-classes.

questions.question: Two vertically adjacent block siblings have margin-bottom: 20px and margin-top: 30px. What is the gap between them?
questions.explanation: Adjacent vertical margins collapse to the larger of the two.

questions.question: On which element does z-index have no effect?
options: A position: static block that is not a flex or grid item
questions.explanation: z-index applies to positioned elements and to flex/grid items.

questions.question: When is blue used in color: var(--main, blue);?
options: When the browser lacks color support
questions.explanation: The second argument of var() is a fallback used when the custom property is not set.

questions.question: Which declaration creates a new stacking context on an element?
questions.explanation: An opacity value less than 1 creates a stacking context.

questions.question: What specificity does :where(.a, #b) contribute?
options: That of #b, the most specific argument
questions.explanation: :where() always has zero specificity, unlike :is() which takes its most specific argument.

questions.question: What does flex: 1; expand to?
questions.explanation: A single unitless number sets flex-grow and makes flex-basis 0%, with flex-shrink 1.
